auto.question: Please describe three features or service differentiators that you believe provide significant benefits over and above your competitors?
auto.answer:
Consulting.  Data management and distribution is SLIP Stream’s sole business function. As such, its expertise in this area is without peer. SLIP Stream leverages this expertise on behalf its manager clients through quarterly, ongoing database consulting. SLIP Stream has the most comprehensive database research function in the industry, with more than 50 fact sheets detailing the databases with which the firm works. SLIP Stream database consulting enables manager clients to make informed, effective decisions with regard to database footprint growth.

Independence and Client Focus.  Relatedly, SLIP Stream’s independence from corporate ownership ensures that every client-facing decision supports the manager’s strategic goals. SLIP Stream has no conflicts of interest that might influence its decision-making process – every action taken by SLIP Stream is with the intention of assisting the manager client to grow and retain AUM through effective integration of data marketing within the manager client’s broader marketing strategy.

Technology.  SLIP Stream manages a team of internal, dedicated software developers whose focus is to enhance the ConsultDB’s utility for each manager client. Many of the ConsultDB’s most significant improvements originated from client suggestions, and the SLIP Stream Development Team’s focus is to ensure those suggestions are quickly and effectively integrated into the ConsultDB’s functionality (SLIP Stream absorbs all costs associated with client requests for ConsultDB development). SLIP Stream’s in-house Development Team ensures the ConsultDB will seamlessly manage Insight’s data intake through any means Insight prefers. Unsurprisingly, the reason SLIP Stream is the most affordable solution in the industry is due to the reliable effectiveness of the software code, coupled with SLIP Stream’s expert Senior Analyst Team. SLIP Stream believes that effective software creates scalability, which drives down costs, and SLIP Stream can then pass those cost savings along to its manager clients.
